issues.text: Day one. Six p.m. Your phone says... two thousand eight hundred.
issues.heard: day one 6 pm your phone says 2800

text: Day one. Six p.m. Your phone says... two thousand eight hundred. {playful} You walk to the grocery store. Then the long way back. Then laps around your building's parking lot. And you find the first hidden cost. Ten thousand steps take an hour and a half to two hours. Over a year, that's around twenty-five full days of just... walking. {deadpan} Eleven fifty p.m. You're pacing your bedroom. Nine thousand nine hundred and ninety. (beat) Done.
